title: I integrated Claude into my backtesting app and it's actually pretty useful
author: According-Hippo-2206
selftext:
So in short what I did was create a backtesting tool that automatically feeds your trades to claude, so that it can find patterns in your trading. This data includes trade screenshots, entry and exit times, the asset that was traded, and much more.

I initially built the tool for myself to help refine my trading strategy and improve my backtesting, but a lot of people have asked me for access so I recently made it public.

I also added a new feature that allows you to journal your own trades manually, so it functions as a trading journal that has AI intelligence.

In addition, as the AI analyses more of your trades, you can use it to refine your strategy and even build new strategies based on your trading data and personality.

Currently it has helped me find data such as what times of day my strategy works better, and which rules I should add or remove from my strategy to increase profitability.

What do you think?

If you'd like to check it out, here's [TradeSpark](https://www.tradesparkjournal.com/)
